verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents its own natural-language interface, the Query Agent, which lets users 'get answers from your data by using a natural language prompt/question'. It is cloud-only and covers querying and agentic search rather than operating the whole product. The MCP server lets external LLMs and IDE assistants interact with an instance, but that is a building block for third-party agents rather than a built-in natural-language command surface. Missing for 10: natural-language commands for admin and management operations (collections, tenants, backups), availability outside Weaviate Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
